## Small Castle This "fourth class" move completely encloses a corner from the star point. (p. 16.) If either of the two additional moves is neglected, White can successfully invade the corner. (p. 3; see also [Invading a small castle](https://badukmovies.com/episodes/invading-a-small-castle) at 0:32.) is a standard reduction technique.
can be a probe or a genuine attempt at life by exploiting nearby aji.
